name: USSF-627
destination_explanation: A satellite this low sweeps across the sky in a few minutes, so a ground station only gets a short window to talk to it on each pass.
slot_a_text: B1103 is flying for the 7th time. Recovery is 574 km downrange, on the drone ship Of Course I Still Love You. Its previous trip was SDA Tranche 1 Transport Layer A, 30 days ago.
slot_b_text: SpaceX's 126th launch of the year, 745th all time. That is a launch every other day. No Falcon 9 has failed in 347 flights. It is the 262nd orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.

lg_slot_b_text: It has already slipped twice. The current time was set 6 days ago and has held since. There is a 4-hour window to work with.
lg_slot_c_text: Astronauts on the International Space Station witness 16 sunrises and sunsets every single day.
description: A classified mission for the United States Space Force. It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites based on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches.
